text: Viktor Quinlan gave Kingsmoor FC a strong 2-0 lead with a smart finish from close range after a patient 8-pass build-up that started with Andre Fairweather’s interception deep in their own half. Felix Duarte’s well-placed cross set up Quinlan, who scored with a shot that had about a 29% chance of going in, meaning it was a decent but not guaranteed chance. Kingsmoor’s wide and crossing game paid off nicely against Westport Albion, who had more of the ball but couldn’t stop this well-organized move. This goal shows how Kingsmoor’s teamwork and passing can break down Westport’s direct style. [#211] [#216] [#218] [#220] [#222]
